objective: Implement the first bounded offline phase of the microstructure V3 evidence handoff: freeze strict manifest and result schemas, one shared validator, and focused fail-closed tests for an immutable 30-file package carrying exactly 14 accepted Server Canonical V3 days into the existing message-dispatched Local Research Session. Bind canonical state bytes/hash, ordered bundle and envelope bytes/hashes, chain, frozen contracts, source release provenance, exact task id/SHA, inference boundaries, and create-only result identity. This phase must not add an exporter, transfer command, Local runner, timer, server writer, analyzer execution, deployment, or performance claim.

inputs.locator: Server V3 source release 20260806T162152Z is active; canonical V3 state WAITING_FOR_DAY 0/14 with untouched start_day 2026-08-08; Cloud Ops V6 is the sole clock; this offline task neither reads nor writes the server

stop_conditions: Change exactly four new files and no others: research_pipeline/microstructure-handoff-manifest.v1.schema.json, research_pipeline/microstructure-handoff-result.v1.schema.json, research_pipeline/microstructure_handoff.py, and research_pipeline/tests/test_microstructure_handoff_contract.py. Preserve this task file and all existing bytes.

Freeze manifest_type MICROSTRUCTURE_V3_CREATE_ONLY_HANDOFF_MANIFEST and exact top-level keys schema_version, manifest_type, authorization, task_id, task_sha256, canonical_state, source_release, days, inference_boundaries, and seal. Reject missing, extra, duplicate, noncanonical, or non-UTF-8 JSON.

The package must contain exactly 30 regular non-link files: handoff-manifest.json; canonical/<diagnostic_id>.json; and one fixed bundle plus one fixed .envelope.json beneath days/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ for each of 14 ordered contiguous days. Reject absolute paths, parent traversal, alternate separators, links, Windows reparse points, extras, missing files, and duplicate identities.

Bind the exact validated task id and SHA, canonical V3 state bytes/SHA/status DIAGNOSTIC_READY, start/last day, 14/14 counts, chain head, V3 source/envelope/state/day/diagnostic hashes, installed producer_release_id and producer_manifest_sha256, and all ordered day bundle/envelope/predecessor/cumulative-chain identities.

Revalidate every raw state, V3 day, and V3 envelope byte sequence with existing explicit V3 APIs. Every manifest day must match its state record, fixed filename, envelope day/source release, predecessor and cumulative chain. All 14 envelopes must name one identical source release and manifest hash; reject V2 and source/state drift.

The manifest seal and result seal are SHA-256 over compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON excluding only the top-level seal. Schema validation must use exact keys and additionalProperties false throughout; schema files are frozen evidence contracts and cannot refer to external network resources at runtime.

Freeze result_type MICROSTRUCTURE_V3_CREATE_ONLY_HANDOFF_RESULT with exact task, input manifest, canonical state, diagnostic contract, diagnostic payload hashes, embedded diagnostic_result, inference boundaries, and seal. The outer result must preserve discovery-only, no-candidate, no-OOS, no-PnL inference boundaries.

Provide one reusable exclusive-create helper for result bytes: create parents only beneath its caller-provided task-owned root in offline tests; an absent target is written once, byte-identical existing content is accepted without rewrite, and any different existing content, link/reparse parent or target, partial file, or invalid bytes fails closed. Do not add fixed production roots yet.

The shared module may accept Path objects only as a library seam for offline tests; it must not parse command-line paths, scan directories for work, start analysis, transfer files, access a server, or write canonical state. No executable path, server root, output path, timer, callback, URL, or command is allowed in either schema.

Focused tests must cover valid canonical 30-file closure; 13/15 days; gaps/order/swaps; state, chain, task, contract and source-release mismatch; path traversal, absolute and alternate separators; symlink and reparse rejection where platform-supported; duplicates/extras/missing/partial files; V2 rejection; exact result retry; conflicting existing result; and noncanonical or duplicate-key JSON.

If this requires editing an existing file, adding a fifth implementation file, executing the analyzer, or implementing server export, Manager transfer, Local runner, package/deploy wiring, or a timer, stop BLOCKED and report the exact missing proof. Do not broaden scope or weaken checks.

Run exact task validation, focused unittest for test_microstructure_handoff_contract.py, Python compile checks for the two new Python files, schema parse checks, and git diff --check. Do not run Java, Maven, network, server, source, deployment, analyzer, evidence, candidate, OOS, or Trading actions.

Return one valid local-research-result JSON with exact task SHA, exactly four files_changed/artifacts, all safety assertions false, concrete test counts, and MISSING_PROOF for live retained bytes, Linux/Windows roots, exporter/transfer/runner, 14-day evidence, predictive value, fees, slippage, PnL, and drawdown.

Stop after offline handoff contract proof. Manager review and commit are separate; server exporter, fixed-root transfer, Local analyzer runner, deploy wiring, live execution, candidate registration, and OOS remain later bounded gates.
